section_1_cloze.passage:
How do we measure what makes a good conversation? Is it by how many times we laugh? Or is it [41] by how we feel afterwards — how deeply the words have [42] us? There is one conversation I can [43] almost word for word in my head. These words have even [44] the course of my life.
In 2016, I walked into a small valley in Jordan. A young boy called Faisal saw me kicking a football with some kids and [45] me.
"I saw you playing football," he told me. "You were very good."
"Thanks," I replied, "but you're being too [46]. I am not good at it."
"Oh yes," he said. "Your skills are [47]. But it was good of you to play with the boys."
He told me about his two jobs — one looking after sheep in the hills, and one looking after tourists. The sheep were easier, he said. Later, as he [48] how the world was, he told me the saying: "Give without remembering; take without [49]."
Faisal's background was quite different from mine. And yet he held this [50] philosophy, and the more I travel, the more I see that the world is [51] a good place. There is more that connects us than divides us — of that, I'm certain.
The fact that I will again have the [52] to be part of these remarkable conversations — each of which will be unique, and may even leave a [53] in my life — is still one of the most exciting [54] of travel for me. For that possibility, I'm forever [55].

questions.explanation: 第一句话提出问题“我们如何衡量什么是一次好的对话？”。第二句和第三句分别提供两种衡量标准，此处句式与上文呼应，define (定义) 与 measure (衡量) 语义相近，指“一次好的对话是否由我们事后的感受所定义”。
questions.supplement:
A(surrounded)：语境句：The house is surrounded by beautiful trees. 固定搭配：be surrounded by/with, surround oneself with
B(replaced)：语境句：The old computers have been replaced by new ones. 固定搭配：replace A with B, be replaced by
C(accompanied)：语境句：Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. 固定搭配：be accompanied by, accompany sb to a place
D(defined)：语境句：Success is often defined by the goals you achieve. 固定搭配：define A as B, well-defined

questions.explanation: 破折号后进一步解释“感受”，即这些话语深深地“影响 (affected)”了我们。下文提到某次对话甚至改变了作者的人生轨迹，正好印证了这种深远的影响。其它选项不符合语境中的正面且深刻的情感体验。
questions.supplement:
A(affected)：语境句：The local economy was deeply affected by the severe weather. 固定搭配：be deeply affected, affect one's mood
B(annoyed)：语境句：I was annoyed by his constant interruptions. 固定搭配：be annoyed at/by, annoy sb with sth
C(concerned)：语境句：We are deeply concerned about the environmental issues. 固定搭配：be concerned about, as far as I am concerned
D(surprised)：语境句：She was surprised at the sudden change in his attitude. 固定搭配：be surprised at/by, to one's surprise

questions.explanation: 根据后文“almost word for word in my head”（几乎一字不差地在脑海中），说明作者可以在脑海中清晰地“重播 (replay)”这次对话。
questions.supplement:
A(polish)：语境句：You need to polish your essay before submitting it. 固定搭配：polish up, polish one's skills
B(replay)：语境句：He tends to replay the events of the day in his mind before falling asleep. 固定搭配：replay a match, replay in one's mind
C(interpret)：语境句：It's difficult to interpret the hidden meaning of this poem. 固定搭配：interpret A as B, interpret dreams
D(rewrite)：语境句：The author had to rewrite the whole chapter. 固定搭配：rewrite history, rewrite the rules

questions.explanation: 根据常识和后文描述，一次深远的对话不仅留在脑海里，甚至“改变 (changed)”了作者人生的轨迹 (the course of my life)。
questions.supplement:
A(restricted)：语境句：Our view of the stage was restricted by a large pillar. 固定搭配：be restricted to, restrict one's freedom
B(dominated)：语境句：The conversation was dominated by him, leaving no room for others to speak. 固定搭配：dominate the market, be dominated by
C(changed)：语境句：The invention of the smartphone has profoundly changed our lives. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change the course of
D(delayed)：语境句：The flight was delayed due to the heavy fog. 固定搭配：delay doing sth, without delay

questions.explanation: 根据上文“saw me kicking a football”和下文男孩主动与作者搭话，可知男孩看到了作者并“走近 (approached)”了作者。
questions.supplement:
A(approached)：语境句：As winter approached, the days grew shorter. 固定搭配：approach sb, an approach to doing sth
B(challenged)：语境句：He challenged the champion to a match. 固定搭配：challenge sb to do sth, face a challenge
C(assisted)：语境句：The professor was assisted by a team of researchers. 固定搭配：assist sb in doing sth, assist with sth
D(consulted)：语境句：If the symptoms persist, you should consult a doctor. 固定搭配：consult sb about sth, consult a dictionary

questions.explanation: 男孩夸赞作者踢得好，作者谦虚地回应：“你太慷慨了 (generous) / 你过奖了，我并不擅长。” generous 这里指在赞美上毫不吝啬。
questions.supplement:
A(humorous)：语境句：He is a humorous writer who always makes readers laugh. 固定搭配：a humorous story, a humorous remark
B(generous)：语境句：It was generous of her to donate so much money to the charity. 固定搭配：be generous with/to, it is generous of sb
C(anxious)：语境句：Students are understandably anxious about their exam results. 固定搭配：be anxious about, be anxious to do sth
D(curious)：语境句：Children are naturally curious about the world around them. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity

questions.explanation: 作者说自己踢得不好，男孩回答“Oh yes”，意为“哦是的（你确实踢得不好）”，紧接着说“Your skills are...”，故此处填 terrible，表示你的技术确实很糟糕。这与后文“但你能和孩子们一起玩很好”形成转折对照。
questions.supplement:
A(terrible)：语境句：The weather was terrible, so we had to cancel the picnic. 固定搭配：feel terrible, a terrible mistake
B(unique)：语境句：Each person's fingerprints are absolutely unique. 固定搭配：be unique to, a unique opportunity
C(practical)：语境句：He offered some practical advice on how to save money. 固定搭配：practical experience, practical skills
D(diverse)：语境句：The city has a diverse population from all over the world. 固定搭配：culturally diverse, biologically diverse

questions.explanation: 男孩与作者探讨世界的运作方式，此处表达他对世界法则的“思考/反思 (reflected on)”，随后引出了他的那句名言。
questions.supplement:
A(complained about)：语境句：Many passengers complained about the poor service. 固定搭配：complain to sb about sth, complain of
B(looked into)：语境句：The police are looking into the cause of the accident. 固定搭配：look into a matter, look into the mirror
C(reflected on)：语境句：He took a moment to reflect on his past mistakes. 固定搭配：reflect on/upon, reflect reality
D(benefited from)：语境句：Students have greatly benefited from the new educational program. 固定搭配：benefit from, for the benefit of

questions.explanation: 男孩引用的谚语运用了对仗结构：“Give without remembering (施恩不图报); take without [forgetting] (受恩不忘报)”。forgetting 与 remembering 形成反义词对照。
questions.supplement:
A(thinking)：语境句：She sat by the window, thinking deeply about her future. 固定搭配：think of/about, without thinking
B(noticing)：语境句：He slipped out of the room without anyone noticing. 固定搭配：take notice of, escape one's notice
C(announcing)：语境句：The government is announcing new tax policies today. 固定搭配：announce sth to sb, announce a decision
D(forgetting)：语境句：She walked away, completely forgetting her umbrella. 固定搭配：forget to do, forget doing

questions.explanation: 虽然男孩的背景与作者截然不同，但他却抱有这种令人“钦佩的/赞叹的 (admirable)”人生哲学。此空表达作者的正面评价。
questions.supplement:
A(complex)：语境句：The human brain is a highly complex organ. 固定搭配：a complex issue, a complex system
B(adjustable)：语境句：The car seat is adjustable for maximum comfort. 固定搭配：highly adjustable, easily adjustable
C(flexible)：语境句：We need a flexible schedule to deal with unexpected events. 固定搭配：flexible working hours, be flexible with
D(admirable)：语境句：Her dedication to helping the poor is truly admirable. 固定搭配：an admirable quality, an admirable effort

questions.explanation: 作者感慨走得越多，越能看清世界“大部分时候 / 总体上 (mostly)”是一个美好的地方。联系后文“连接我们的东西多于分开我们的东西”，mostly 符合这种总体基调。
questions.supplement:
A(rarely)：语境句：He rarely goes out after dark due to safety concerns. 固定搭配：rarely if ever, very rarely
B(probably)：语境句：It will probably rain tomorrow according to the forecast. 固定搭配：most probably, very probably
C(mostly)：语境句：The audience consisted mostly of young teenagers. 固定搭配：mostly true, mostly because
D(merely)：语境句：He didn't mean to offend you; he was merely joking. 固定搭配：merely a formality, not merely... but also

questions.explanation: 作者再次拥有“机会 (chance)”参与到这些非凡的对话中，这是旅行最令人兴奋的方面之一。have the chance to do 意为“有机会做某事”。
questions.supplement:
A(patience)：语境句：Teaching young children requires a great deal of patience. 固定搭配：have patience with, lose patience
B(courage)：语境句：It takes courage to speak the truth in difficult situations. 固定搭配：have the courage to do, gather courage
C(right)：语境句：Everyone has the right to free speech. 固定搭配：have the right to do, human rights
D(chance)：语境句：I never had the chance to thank him properly. 固定搭配：by chance, take a chance

questions.explanation: 根据语境，每次对话都是独一无二的，甚至可能会在我的生命中留下“印记 (mark)”。leave a mark 为常见搭配，意为留下深刻影响。
questions.supplement:
A(mark)：语境句：His inspirational speech left a deep mark on my heart. 固定搭配：leave a mark on, make one's mark
B(pity)：语境句：It is a pity that she couldn't attend the ceremony. 固定搭配：feel pity for, what a pity
C(label)：语境句：Please read the label carefully before taking the medicine. 固定搭配：put a label on, designer label
D(warning)：语境句：The dark clouds served as a warning of the coming storm. 固定搭配：give a warning, without warning

questions.explanation: 这种能在未来发生的“可能性”（后文的 For that possibility 提供了直接线索），即前景或预期 (prospects)，是旅行中最令人兴奋的。prospect 此处指“预期发生的事，前景”。
questions.supplement:
A(breakthroughs)：语境句：Scientists have made major breakthroughs in cancer treatment. 固定搭配：make a breakthrough, technological breakthroughs
B(prospects)：语境句：Job prospects for computer science graduates are excellent. 固定搭配：future prospects, the prospect of doing sth
C(adventures)：语境句：He spent his youth traveling and looking for adventures. 固定搭配：a sense of adventure, seek adventure
D(memories)：语境句：The old photographs brought back fond memories of childhood. 固定搭配：bring back memories, have a good memory

questions.explanation: 因为旅行能带来这些建立连接并改变一生的可能性，所以作者对此心存“感激 (grateful)”。
questions.supplement:
A(qualified)：语境句：She is highly qualified for this demanding position. 固定搭配：be qualified for, highly qualified
B(suitable)：语境句：This movie is not suitable for children under the age of 13. 固定搭配：be suitable for, highly suitable
C(grateful)：语境句：I am deeply grateful for your support during hard times. 固定搭配：be grateful to sb for sth, deeply grateful
D(responsible)：语境句：Who is responsible for the damage to the car? 固定搭配：be responsible for, hold sb responsible

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a meaningful or enjoyable conversation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语what视为第三人称单数，谓语用makes；短语make a good conversation意为「进行一场好的对话」。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is not easy to make a good conversation with someone you have just met.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 与刚认识的人进行一场好的对话并不容易。
vocab_pack.from_passage: makes a good conversation

vocab_pack.definition_en: exactly as spoken or written, without any changes
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，作状语修饰replay，表示「逐字地重复」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She repeated the poem word for word from memory.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她凭记忆一字不差地背诵了那首诗。
vocab_pack.from_passage: replay almost word for word

vocab_pack.term: change the course of one's life
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: changed the course of my life
vocab_pack.definition_en: to significantly alter the direction or outcome of one's life
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时态，changed为及物动词过去式，the course of my life作宾语，表示「改变了我的人生方向」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Winning that scholarship changed the course of her life forever.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 赢得那份奖学金永远改变了她的人生轨迹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: changed the course of my life

vocab_pack.definition_en: to enter a place by walking
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，walked为walk的过去式；into为介词，表示「进入」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He walked into the room and greeted everyone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他走进房间，向每个人打招呼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: walked into a small valley

vocab_pack.definition_en: to perceive someone in the act of doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，saw是see的过去式；后接宾语me和现在分词kicking作宾语补足语，表示看见动作的一部分或整个过程。
vocab_pack.example_en: I saw him crossing the street when the accident happened.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 事故发生时我看见他正在过马路。
vocab_pack.from_passage: saw me kicking a football

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come near or closer to someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，approached为及物动词，表示「走近（某人）」。
vocab_pack.example_en: As we approached the city, the traffic became heavier.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着我们接近城市，交通变得繁忙起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: approached me

vocab_pack.term: it is good of someone to do something
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: it was good of you to play
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to praise someone for being kind or generous to do something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 某人做某事真是太好了
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，it为形式主语，真正主语是不定式to play；was为be的过去式；of引出行为主体you。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is good of you to help me with my homework.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你帮我做功课真是太好了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it was good of you to play with the boys

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give information to someone regarding a particular topic
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，told是tell的过去式；me为间接宾语，about引出直接话题内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: Can you tell me about your trip to Japan?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你能跟我讲讲你的日本之旅吗？
vocab_pack.from_passage: He told me about his two jobs

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take care of someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词形式，在句中作后置定语修饰one（一份工作），表示「照看羊的工作」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She looks after her younger brother while their parents are at work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 父母上班时，她照看弟弟。
vocab_pack.from_passage: one looking after sheep

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think deeply or carefully about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，reflected为reflect的过去式；on为介词，引出思考的对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should reflect on our mistakes and learn from them.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该反思自己的错误并从中学习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: reflected on how the world was

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be unlike someone or something in some way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，was为be的过去式；different from后接名词短语，表示「与……不同」。
vocab_pack.example_en: His opinion is different from mine on this issue.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在这个问题上他的观点与我不同。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was quite different from mine

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a particular set of beliefs or principles
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，held为hold的过去式；this admirable philosophy作宾语，表示「持有这种令人钦佩的哲学」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He holds a philosophy that emphasizes kindness and generosity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他秉持一种强调善良和慷慨的人生哲学。
vocab_pack.from_passage: held this admirable philosophy

vocab_pack.definition_en: deserving respect and approval
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 令人钦佩的，值得赞赏的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰philosophy，表示「令人钦佩的哲学」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her dedication to helping others is truly admirable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她致力于帮助他人的精神确实令人钦佩。
vocab_pack.from_passage: this admirable philosophy

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: the more I travel, the more I see
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to indicate that two things increase or decrease together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定平行结构，两个the more分别引导比较状语从句和主句，前后都用一般现在时。表示「我旅行得越多，就看见越多」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The more you practice, the more confident you become.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你练习得越多，就越自信。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the more I travel, the more I see

vocab_pack.definition_en: mainly; for the most part
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词，修饰系动词is，表示「大部分是」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The audience was mostly made up of young people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 观众主要由年轻人组成。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the world is mostly a good place

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring together or join two or more things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语关系代词that（指代more）视为第三人称单数，故动词用connects；意为「连接我们」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Music connects people from different cultures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐连接了来自不同文化的人们。
vocab_pack.from_passage: connects us

vocab_pack.definition_en: to separate or cause to be separate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语that（指代more）为单数，动词用divides；与connects并列，表示「分裂我们」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Political disagreements can divide a community.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政治分歧可以分裂一个社区。
vocab_pack.from_passage: divides us

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be completely sure about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 主系表结构，I'm = I am；certain为形容词；句中of that前置，正常语序为I'm certain of that。表示「我对此确信」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is certain of her success in the exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她确信自己能通过考试。
vocab_pack.from_passage: of that, I'm certain

vocab_pack.term: have the chance to do something
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: have the chance to be part
vocab_pack.definition_en: to be given an opportunity to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 将来时will have中have为动词原形；have the chance后接不定式to be part，表示「有机会成为……的一部分」。
vocab_pack.example_en: I hope to have the chance to visit the Great Wall one day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我希望有一天有机会参观长城。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I will again have the chance to be part

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be included or involved in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，be为原形；part of后接名词短语，表示「成为这些非凡对话的一部分」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Every student should be part of the school community.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个学生都应该成为学校社区的一部分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to be part of these remarkable conversations

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a lasting effect or impression
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词may后接动词原形leave；a mark作宾语，表示「留下印记」。
vocab_pack.example_en: His speech left a mark on everyone who heard it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的演讲给每个听到的人留下了深刻印象。
vocab_pack.from_passage: may even leave a mark in my life

vocab_pack.definition_en: the possibility or likelihood of future success or something happening
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词复数形式，与exciting搭配，作介词of的宾语，表示「最令人兴奋的前景之一」。
vocab_pack.example_en: There are good prospects for economic growth this year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 今年经济增长前景良好。
vocab_pack.from_passage: one of the most exciting prospects

vocab_pack.definition_en: to feel thankful for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 主系表结构，I'm forever grateful；grateful为形容词；介词for后引出感谢的原因（句中for that possibility前置）。
vocab_pack.example_en: We are grateful for your generous donation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们感谢您的慷慨捐赠。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'm forever grateful

vocab_pack.definition_en: for all time; permanently
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词，修饰形容词grateful，表示「永远感激」。
vocab_pack.example_en: I will remember that lesson forever.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我会永远记住那个教训。
vocab_pack.from_passage: forever grateful

vocab_pack.definition_en: unusual or surprising in a way that causes people to notice
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰conversations，表示「非凡的对话」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has made remarkable progress in her studies.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在学业上取得了显著的进步。
vocab_pack.from_passage: these remarkable conversations

vocab_pack.definition_en: being the only one of its kind; very special
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，与will be构成系表结构，表示「将是独一无二的」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Each person has a unique personality.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都有独特的个性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: each of which will be unique

vocab_pack.definition_en: to play again, especially in one's mind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词can后接动词原形，表示「能够在脑海中重现这段对话」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He often replays the highlights of the game in his head.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他经常在脑海中重现比赛的精彩片段。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I can replay almost word for word

vocab_pack.definition_en: willing to give more than is expected or necessary
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，在you're being too generous中作表语；be being + 形容词表示「一时表现出某种状态」，此处意为「你太客气了」。
vocab_pack.example_en: It was generous of him to offer to pay for our dinner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他主动提出支付我们的晚餐，真是太慷慨了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: you're being too generous

vocab_pack.definition_en: a set of beliefs or principles that guide someone's behavior
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词单数，作held的宾语，并受this admirable修饰，表示「这种令人钦佩的人生哲学」。
vocab_pack.example_en: His philosophy of life is to help others as much as possible.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的人生哲学是尽可能帮助他人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: held this admirable philosophy

vocab_pack.definition_en: while not failing to remember; retaining in memory
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词without后接动名词forgetting，构成介词短语；在句中与giving/taking搭配，形成「给予而不记；接受而不忘」的平行结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: Learn from your mistakes without forgetting the lessons they taught.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从错误中学习，不忘它们教会你的教训。
vocab_pack.from_passage: take without forgetting

questions.explanation: 此处作主语，且谓语动词是复数的 were，因此需将 passer-by 变为复数形式。复合名词 passer-by 的复数变化在核心词 passer 上，故为 passers-by。
questions.supplement: 正确形(passers-by)：语境句：Several passers-by stopped to help the injured man. 固定搭配：innocent passers-by, random passers-by。原词其它变形：pass(v.), passing(adj./n.)

questions.explanation: 此处需填入形容词作定语修饰名词 singing，infect 的形容词 infectious 意为“有感染力的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(infectious)：语境句：His laughter is so infectious that everyone in the room starts smiling. 固定搭配：infectious diseases, an infectious laugh。原词其它变形：infection(n.), infect(v.)

questions.explanation: 此处修饰谓语动词 spread，需要用副词形式。subsequent 变为 subsequently，意为“随后地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(subsequently)：语境句：He was badly injured and subsequently died in the hospital. 固定搭配：subsequently proved, happen subsequently。原词其它变形：subsequence(n.), subsequent(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 relate to sb/sth，意为“对……产生共鸣、理解或认同”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：Teenagers often find it hard to relate to their parents. 固定搭配：relate to, in relation to。原词其它变形：relation(n.), relative(adj./n.)

questions.explanation: 此处为 no matter what 引导的让步状语从句，相当于 whatever，what 在从句中作 going through 的宾语，意为“无论人们正在经历什么”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：No matter what happens, I will always be by your side. 固定搭配：no matter what, what to do。原词其它变形：whatever(pron.)

questions.explanation: 该句主语是 The choir，为单数第三人称。由于陈述的是一个客观事实，使用一般现在时，故填 consists。
questions.supplement: 正确形(consists)：语境句：A typical nuclear family consists of parents and their children. 固定搭配：consist of, consist in。原词其它变形：consistent(adj.), consistency(n.)

questions.explanation: signature song 意为“代表作”，是可数名词单数，此处表示泛指“一首代表作”，且 signature 辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：This is a difficult question to answer. 固定搭配：a piece of, as a result。原词其它变形：an (用于元音音素前)

questions.explanation: 此处与主语 Fukuda and the children 之间为主动关系，且伴随谓语动作 teared up 发生，作伴随状语，需用现在分词 waving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(waving)：语境句：The crowd stood by the road, waving flags and cheering. 固定搭配：wave goodbye to, wave hands。原词其它变形：wave(n./v.), waved(past/ptcp.)

questions.explanation: feel 为系动词，其后需接形容词作表语。connect 的形容词 connected (感到有联系的/息息相关的) 符合语境。feel connected to 意为“感觉与……心灵相通”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(connected)：语境句：Social media helps us stay connected with friends abroad. 固定搭配：feel connected to, stay connected。原词其它变形：connection(n.), connect(v.)

questions.explanation: 在 that 引导的宾语从句中，主语 our message 与 receive 构成被动关系。由于主句谓语动词是 felt (一般过去时)，从句需保持时态一致用过去时态，故填一般过去时的被动语态 was received。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was received)：语境句：The proposal was warmly received by the committee. 固定搭配：be warmly received, be well received。原词其它变形：receiver(n.), reception(n.)

vocab_pack.definition_en: to experience pain or difficulty because of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时态 'suffered for'，表示过去发生的动作。'suffer for' 是固定短语，后接原因。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people suffer for their mistakes before they learn.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人在学到教训之前都会为自己的错误受苦。
vocab_pack.from_passage: If you have ever suffered for my sweetness

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be ready and happy to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 'willing to' 前有 'I'm'（am），构成一般现在时第一人称 'I am willing to'。'be willing to' 为固定搭配，后接动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is willing to help anyone in need.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她愿意帮助任何有需要的人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'm willing to live as you wish

vocab_pack.definition_en: in whatever way you want; according to your desire
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中用作状语，修饰动词 'live'，表示方式。'as you wish' 是固定短语，常用于口语或歌词。
vocab_pack.example_en: You may arrange the schedule as you wish.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你可以按照你的意愿安排日程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'm willing to live as you wish

vocab_pack.definition_en: a part of a song that is repeated after each verse; a group of singers
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作主语 'The chorus'，单数名词，后接谓语 'resounded'，表示歌曲的副歌部分。
vocab_pack.example_en: Everyone joined in the chorus of the popular song.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都加入了这首流行歌曲的合唱部分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The chorus of As You Wish resounded at the Temple of Heaven

vocab_pack.definition_en: to fill a place with sound; to echo
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 'resounded'，描述过去发生的事件。主语 'The chorus' 第三人称单数，谓语用 -ed 形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hall resounded with applause after the performance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 表演结束后，大厅里回响起掌声。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The chorus of As You Wish resounded at the Temple of Heaven

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who is walking past a place by chance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 'passers-by'，作主语。注意复数构成为 'passer' 变 'passers' 再加 '-by'。
vocab_pack.example_en: Several passers-by stopped to watch the street performance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 几个路人停下来观看街头表演。
vocab_pack.from_passage: passers-by were surprised to find

vocab_pack.definition_en: to feel unexpected amazement when discovering something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时 'were surprised to find'，主语 'passers-by' 复数，系动词用 were。'be surprised to do' 是固定搭配，表示惊讶于某行为。
vocab_pack.example_en: The students were surprised to find the museum closed on Monday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生们惊讶地发现博物馆周一闭馆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: passers-by were surprised to find this Chinese song

vocab_pack.definition_en: to present a show, play, song, etc. for an audience
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为被动语态 'was performed'，一般过去时，表示歌曲被美国合唱团表演。主语 'this Chinese song' 第三人称单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The play will be performed by local actors next week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部戏下周将由当地演员表演。
vocab_pack.from_passage: this Chinese song was performed by a US choir

vocab_pack.definition_en: spreading quickly to other people; catching
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰 'singing'，形容词表示歌声具有感染力。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her infectious laughter made everyone smile.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她那有感染力的笑声让每个人都笑了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Their infectious singing was recorded

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that becomes very popular immediately
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 即时热门；迅速走红的事物
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，前有不定冠词 'an'，单数。'instant' 为形容词修饰 'hit'，整体为名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new app was an instant hit among teenagers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款新应用在青少年中迅速走红。
vocab_pack.from_passage: became an instant hit on social media

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who directs the performance of an orchestra or choir
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作同位语，指代 'Fukuda' 的身份。
vocab_pack.example_en: The conductor raised his baton to start the symphony.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 指挥举起指挥棒开始交响乐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Fukuda, the conductor, introduced

vocab_pack.definition_en: to present someone or something to others for the first time; to make known
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 'introduced'，后接宾语从句（省略了that），表示介绍了一个事实。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scientist introduced his new theory at the conference.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位科学家在会议上介绍了他新的理论。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Fukuda, the conductor, introduced One Voice Children's Choir was just singing

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come together in a group around someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 'gathered around'，描述人们聚集的动作。'gather around' 是短语动词，后可接名词或单独使用。
vocab_pack.example_en: The children gathered around the storyteller.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们聚集在讲故事的人周围。
vocab_pack.from_passage: when people gathered around

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become widely shared or known through the internet
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 'spread online'（spread的过去式与原形同形），主语 'the video'。'spread' 为动词，'online' 为副词修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: The news spread online within minutes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这条新闻几分钟内就在网上传开了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the video subsequently spread online

vocab_pack.definition_en: in spite of; without being affected by
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中位于句首，后接名词短语 'different cultures'，表示让步。注意 'despite' 后不能接从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: Despite the heavy rain, they continued the match.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管下着大雨，他们还是继续比赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Despite different cultures

vocab_pack.definition_en: to understand or feel sympathy for someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动词原形 'relate to'，位于情态动词 'can' 之后。表示“能够理解那些信息”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many teenagers can relate to the struggles in this movie.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多青少年能理解这部电影中的挣扎。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we can still relate to those same messages

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that something is true or will happen regardless of circumstances
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中引导让步状语从句 'no matter what people are going through'，相当于 'whatever'。
vocab_pack.example_en: No matter what happens, I will always support you.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 无论发生什么，我都会一直支持你。
vocab_pack.from_passage: no matter what people are going through

vocab_pack.definition_en: to experience or endure something (often difficult)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词 'going through'，与 'are' 构成现在进行时 'are going through'，表示正在经历某段时期。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is going through a tough time after losing her job.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她失业后正在经历一段艰难时期。
vocab_pack.from_passage: no matter what people are going through

vocab_pack.definition_en: to affect someone emotionally; to move
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动词原形 'touch'，位于情态动词 'will' 之后，构成一般将来时 'will touch'，表示歌曲将感动人们。
vocab_pack.example_en: The heartfelt speech touched everyone in the room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那场真挚的演讲感动了房间里的每个人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the song will touch them

vocab_pack.definition_en: an important goal or purpose that a person or organization aims to achieve
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词 'with' 的宾语，'with its mission' 表示合唱团带有的使命。名词单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company's mission is to provide clean water for everyone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该公司的使命是为每个人提供清洁的水。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with its mission to inspire the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: to fill someone with the desire or ability to do something creative or positive
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式形式 'to inspire'，作 'mission' 的后置定语，表示“激励世界的使命”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher's words inspired the students to work harder.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师的话激励学生更加努力学习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with its mission to inspire the world through children's voices

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be made up of; to have as parts
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数 'consists of'，主语 'The choir'。注意 'consist of' 不用于被动语态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The committee consists of ten members.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 委员会由十名成员组成。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The choir, with its mission to inspire the world through children's voices, consists of a group of children

vocab_pack.definition_en: as well as; besides
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中位于句首，首字母大写，后接名词短语 'As You Wish'，表示除了这首歌还有另一首。
vocab_pack.example_en: In addition to English, she speaks French and Japanese.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 除了英语，她还会说法语和日语。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In addition to As You Wish, Tomorrow Will Be Better is also a signature song

vocab_pack.definition_en: a song that is closely identified with a particular performer; a representative song
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，前有不定冠词 'a'，单数形式。'signature' 为形容词，意为“标志性的”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The band's signature song is played at every concert.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这支乐队的代表作在每场音乐会上都会演奏。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Tomorrow Will Be Better is also a signature song of them

vocab_pack.definition_en: to finish doing or making something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去分词 'completed'，与 'have' 构成现在完成时 'have completed'，表示“刚刚完成”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team completed the project ahead of schedule.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 团队提前完成了项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: They've just completed their China tour

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start crying; to have tears in one's eyes
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 'teared up'（tear的规则过去式），描述福冈和孩子们当时流泪的动作。'tear up' 为不及物短语动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: During the farewell speech, many audience members teared up.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在告别演讲中，许多观众流下了眼泪。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Fukuda and the children teared up

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move one's hand as a gesture of farewell
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词 'waving goodbye'，作伴随状语，表示在流泪的同时不断地挥手告别。
vocab_pack.example_en: She stood at the station waving goodbye until the train disappeared.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她站在车站挥手告别，直到火车消失。
vocab_pack.from_passage: continuously waving goodbye to the audience

vocab_pack.definition_en: a friendly and enthusiastic reception from others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作主语 'The warm welcome'，后接谓语 'moved'。'welcome' 为名词，'warm' 为形容词修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: The delegation received a warm welcome from the local people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 代表团受到了当地人民的热烈欢迎。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The warm welcome from the Chinese people moved us deeply

vocab_pack.definition_en: to affect someone emotionally; to cause strong feelings (e.g. sadness, gratitude)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 'moved'，及物动词，后接双宾语？实际是 'moved us deeply'，宾语是 'us'，副词 'deeply' 修饰。表示“使我们深深感动”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The documentary about endangered animals moved me to tears.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部关于濒危动物的纪录片感动得我流泪。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The warm welcome ... moved us deeply

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a sense of emotional bond or association with someone/something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 感到与…有联系；与…产生共鸣
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 'felt connected to'，系动词 'felt' 后接形容词 'connected' 和介词 'to'。表示“感到与观众有联系”。
vocab_pack.example_en: After working together for years, the team members feel connected to each other.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一起工作多年后，团队成员彼此感到有紧密联系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I really felt connected to the audience
